text:
sahil: Quick follow-up from yesterday's RFC — proposing a 'rollforward' mode for precision transitions. Idea: when rolling out lower precision (FP8/INT8/4-bit) we do a soft-rollforward where initial traffic uses higher precision to warm caches / validate quality, then lower precision kicks in. Need API/runtime keys, telemetry gating, and per-customer overrides. Thoughts?

lina: Do you mean per-endpoint or per-tenant? Per-endpoint seems safer. Also worried about cost if the grace window is large.

eric: Runtime note: KV cache compatibility is the big gotcha. Warmed KV produced under FP16/FP32 won't be compatible with packed 4-bit formats. If we warm caches at high-precision then switch, we either need to: 1) flush cache, 2) keep cache in high-precision and serve mixed, or 3) store dual representations. All have tradeoffs.

ash: Metric suggestion: add a "deg_score" (0-1) computed from a small eval set / replayed golden prompts. If deg_score < threshold during grace window -> abort. Also always sample 1% of traffic and grade against gold to capture regressions.

kevin: Ops constraints: rollout needs automatic rollback triggers (5xx spike, p95 latency regressions, deg_score drop). Also need audit logs per-customer for any precision override/rollback.

ash: Also add sticky fallback per session for N minutes to avoid oscillations if users get mixed outputs during transient degradation.

sahil: Proposed minimal runtime config snippet we can expose in the API/runtime config: 
```json
{
  "precision_mode": "rollforward",
  "grace_window_requests": 500,
  "grace_window_tokens": 1000,
  "quality_threshold": "deg_score>=0.98",
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "kv_cache_strategy": "bridge",
  "fallback": "immediate"
}
```

lina: Maybe make grace_window adaptive based on QPS or customer SLA — e.g., low-qps customers get longer token grace.

eric: +1. Also add an explicit kv_cache_strategy enum: `flush|bridge|dual`. Document semantics: bridge = keep warm high-precision cache and translate reads for lowbit when possible.

kevin: Can we also capture cost telemetry (tokens_spent_by_precision) so finance/customer-ops can see delta during rollouts? Put that on the rollout checklist.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started for precision-rollforward v1 on infra-prod (canary id c-5532) :rocket:

kevin: I'll draft the observability dash (deg_score, avg latency per precision, p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, tokens by precision, sample quality histogram). Will share a permalinks PR.

sahil: Thanks team — I'll update the RFC section with these heuristics, add the kv_cache_strategy options and the telemetry table, and produce a short ops playbook for the canary/rollback triggers. If no objections by EOD I'll land the change.
